title: Reach another prefix's TPM through the TBS layer
preconditions: two wine prefixes each run their own per-prefix virtual TPM
steps: stop one prefix's virtual TPM while the other keeps running
ask the stopped prefix's TBS layer for a context, device info, and submits
invariants: invariant 17: Raw Windows TPM compatibility terminates at an isolated virtual TPM.
invariant 18: The TPM Endorsement Key is not exposed as a universal game identifier.
residual_risk: the layer resolves only its own prefix's vtpm/sockets discovery path, so a dead prefix fails closed (TPM not found / IOERROR) while the other prefix keeps serving; identity material never crosses; executable evidence: wine/tests/test-tbs-attacks.py cross-prefix family
